publisher: City of Patterson (unofficial copy hosted by J-Mann)
notes: Unofficial copy: personal ArcGIS Online account (J-Mann), not the City of Patterson. Parcel-level polygons (3,724 features, address/lot/block fields) with a Zone attribute holding district codes (R-6, R-10, R-T, M, C, B, I); used as a last resort because the City publishes its zoning maps only as PDFs. Covers the City of Patterson only. Not verified against the city ordinance; no zone_name or ordinance link field.
